name: Green Eggs and Ham
description: Guy-Am-I, an inventor, and his friend Sam-I-Am go on a cross-country trip that would test the limits of their friendship. As they learn to try new things, they find out what adventure brings.

videos.title: Here
videos.overview: Soon after a rare chickeraffe goes missing from the Glurfsburg Zoo, Sam and Guy meet by chance at a diner, setting off a series of extraordinary events.

videos.title: Car
videos.overview: Guy shows up to return Sam's briefcase, only to learn he's got company. Elsewhere, a mother-daughter duo begins a very slow drive through the desert.

videos.title: Train
videos.overview: With the Bad Guys in pursuit, Sam and Guy board a train to Meepville and meet Michellee, a cautious bean counter, and her thrill-seeking daughter, E.B.

videos.title: Fox
videos.overview: Taking a detour to find the chickeraffe some food, Guy and Sam cross paths with an egg-loving fox who's working hard to control his appetite.

videos.title: Dark
videos.overview: While seeking shelter for the night, the trio gets stuck in a junkyard. The only upside for an inventor like Guy? It's full of raw materials.

videos.title: Box
videos.overview: Panic hits the streets of Prinz Pazookle when the locals learn there's a chickeraffe in town. But a colorful carnival is bringing everyone together.

videos.title: Mouse
videos.overview: A singing rodent comes to the rescue in North Shvizelton when Sam and Guy wind up in jail with no real plan to get themselves out.

videos.title: Rain
videos.overview: To escape the Bad Guys -- and stormy weather -- Sam and friends spend the night in Michellee's cabin, but trouble follows. Snerz hires outside help.

videos.title: Goat
videos.overview: Guy and Sam need a next-level plan when Snerz's animal-napper chases them up a cliff. As for the Bad Guys, they're definitely down -- but not out.

videos.title: House
videos.overview: The fugitive friends make a stop in Stovepipe Junction, where Sam gets to meet Guy's family -- and reveals a shocking secret.

videos.title: Boat
videos.overview: Just as Guy's about to try a bite of breakfast, the Bad Guys bust in with the truth about their mission. Under the sea, the plot thickens.

videos.title: There
videos.overview: After a close call on the docks, Guy gets captured and learns he's been duped. Michellee gives her daughter a tour of Meepville.

videos.title: Anywhere
videos.overview: The SnerzDay Gala sets the stage for a surprise ending that's full of twists and turns -- and a heartwarming act of true friendship.

videos.title: The Mom Identity
videos.overview: A taste of home sends Sam on a mission to find his mom, with Guy and E.B. in tow. But a plot twist takes their story in a wildly different direction.

videos.title: Tinker Tailor Mother Spy
videos.overview: The friends hear the histories of Yookia and Zookia. Sam's desperate to connect with Pam, but a suspicious Guy doesn't trust her.

videos.title: Goldenguy
videos.overview: Sam shadows Pam on a super-secret spy mission, even though she'd rather work alone. In tech-loving Zookia, Guy finds an inventor's paradise.

videos.title: Three Days of the Mom-dor
videos.overview: Pam and Sam team up for an undercover job. A scampering squail leads E.B. to the top of the border wall, where she makes a mysterious new friend.

videos.title: To Yookia With Love
videos.overview: E.B. runs away to spend the day with Looka. Everything's perfect - until a hidden relic reveals the truth about the history of the wall.

videos.title: You Only Mom Twice
videos.overview: Sam and his mom track the Moo-Lacka-Moo to a tropical island crawling with surprises. Guy gets Michellee's message and can't believe his eyes.

videos.title: Guyfall
videos.overview: A well-meaning Guy saves E.B. from danger and shares his doubts about Pam with Sam - but it only seems to push them both further away from him.

videos.title: The Sam Who Came in From the Cold
videos.overview: So who gets the Moo-Lacka-Moo? With the fate of Yookia and Zookia hanging in the balance, the friends must decide where their loyalties lie.

videos.title: On Her Dookess' Secret Service
videos.overview: Pam is forced to pick sides as the Zooks and Yooks prepare for an all-out war. A quick-thinking Michellee is Guy's secret weapon.

videos.title: The Mom Who Loved Me
videos.overview: Butter side up, butter side down: The great butter battle is brewing! Can our heroes work together to stop it in time?
